title: The Phantom Token Approval

captures.note: approve UNLIMITED USDC, then swap tx 0x1711ba3f67a6345edf6ce73713e825bdf87c81e5bbf8cbc8c511a92e349a13f8

_comment: Selling 0.5 USDC for ETH in Phantom's Swap. Two txs, both through Phantom's submission service: approve() for the MAXIMUM amount (2^256−1, unlimited) of USDC to TokenApprove 0x40aa…cd7f (Sourcify name), then the swap via DexRouter 0x8fea…b4f6. Of the four wallets tested Oct 2 (Rabby, Rainbow, Coinbase, Phantom), Phantom is the only one that granted an unlimited allowance. Approval tx 0xb6d772035eff4f58bc88690ba27634155f179a88c3e7fa52413310457e02b1a0, swap tx 0x1711ba3f67a6345edf6ce73713e825bdf87c81e5bbf8cbc8c511a92e349a13f8.
